system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Uncommon, Salt. 1 item slot (Small). Attunement.

A small, tarnished coin, marred on one side. It looks very innocuous.

Bargain Hunter (Passive): This coin is worth 1gp. Whenever you take the Shop Long Rest action, you may re-roll any single die you roll to Shop. You must keep the second result.

Rulebook p.35.
